seoTitle: Dragon Ball Z Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Dragon Ball Z test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, Krillin, Bulma, Chi-Chi, Mr. Satan or Majin Buu — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the pure heart, the proud prince or the big kid with a sweet tooth? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, rivals and family, and find out which Dragon Ball Z character you are.

characters.name: Goku
characters.title: The Pure Heart
characters.summary: Cheerful, kind and always looking for the next challenge. You see the good in everyone, even your rivals.
description: Like Goku, you've got a pure heart. He's devoted to protecting Earth and the people on it.
You love a challenge. Goku is extremely competitive, and always looking for a stronger opponent.
You don't let your past define you. Goku was born a Saiyan named Kakarot, and raised by his adoptive grandfather, Gohan.
characters.flaw: You get so excited about the next challenge that you forget everything else.
characters.signature: A big grin, a stretch and 'Let's go!'
characters.clashReason: they'd skip your plans because something more exciting came up

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.title: The Proud Prince
characters.summary: Proud, driven and refusing to lose. You push yourself harder than anyone, and you soften for the few who earn it.
description: Like Vegeta, you carry yourself like royalty. He's the last prince of the Saiyans.
Your pride drives you, sometimes too far. Vegeta's immense pride is both his strength and his biggest flaw.
You change, slowly. Vegeta goes from villain to hero, and builds a family with Bulma.
characters.flaw: Your pride makes it almost impossible to admit you need help.
characters.signature: Crossed arms, a scowl and a vow to be better than everyone.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a contest they refuse to lose

characters.name: Gohan
characters.title: The Gentle Powerhouse
characters.summary: Kind, studious and stronger than anyone realises. You'd rather avoid a fight, but you'll finish it if you have to.
description: Like Gohan, you're gentle by nature. He's Goku's eldest son, and was trained by Piccolo for a year as a child.
You've got hidden strength. Gohan was the one who defeated Cell.
You've got a fun side, too. Gohan fought crime in disguise as the Great Saiyaman.
characters.flaw: You hold back so much that you forget what you're capable of.
characters.signature: A pile of books and a strength you rarely show.
characters.clashReason: they'd always choose studying over hanging out

characters.name: Piccolo
characters.title: The Stern Mentor
characters.summary: Serious, quiet and secretly protective. You don't say much, but you'd do anything for the people you care about.
description: Like Piccolo, you've come a long way. He started as Goku's enemy and became one of Earth's protectors.
You're a natural teacher. Piccolo trained Gohan for a year when he was a child.
Under the stern face, you care deeply. Piccolo once sacrificed himself to protect Gohan.
characters.flaw: You hide your feelings so well that people think you don't have any.
characters.signature: Folded arms, a stern look and a quiet 'well done'.
characters.clashReason: they'd answer your excited story with a single nod

characters.name: Krillin
characters.title: The Loyal Best Friend
characters.summary: Loyal, funny and braver than you think. You're the friend everyone can count on.
description: Like Krillin, you're a loyal friend. He's Goku's best friend, despite starting out as his rival.
You're more skilled than you give yourself credit for. Krillin is a talented martial artist, trained by Master Roshi.
Family means everything. Krillin married Android 18, and they have a daughter, Marron.
characters.flaw: You compare yourself to others and forget how much you bring.
characters.signature: A nervous laugh, a thumbs up and a friend you'd never abandon.
characters.clashReason: they'd worry out loud about everything that could go wrong

characters.name: Bulma
characters.title: The Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, bold and never afraid to take charge. If it's broken, you'll fix it, and tell everyone how.
description: Like Bulma, you're seriously clever. She invented the Dragon Radar.
You're the one who keeps the team going. Bulma is inventive and resourceful, and often provides the tech support.
You know what you want. Bulma married Vegeta, and they have two children, Trunks and Bra.
characters.flaw: You can be bossy when people don't move fast enough.
characters.signature: A toolbox, a big idea and a 'just let me do it'.
characters.clashReason: they'd take over your project because they could do it better

characters.name: Chi-Chi
characters.title: The Protective Parent
characters.summary: Strict, fierce and fiercely protective. You know what's best for the people you love, and you'll tell them.
description: Like Chi-Chi, you're strong-willed. She's the daughter of the Ox-King.
You protect the people you love. Chi-Chi is fiercely protective of her son, Gohan.
You want a calmer life. Chi-Chi wishes Goku would stop fighting and settle down.
characters.flaw: You worry so much that you can come across as controlling.
characters.signature: A raised voice, a firm rule and a lot of love underneath.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what you're doing wrong

characters.name: Mr. Satan
characters.title: The Showman
characters.summary: Loud, flashy and loved by the crowd. You talk big, but there's a good heart underneath.
description: Like Mr. Satan, you love an audience. He's a flamboyant martial artist with a glory-hound streak.
You know how to take the credit. Mr. Satan became a world-famous hero after the Cell Games, even though he was swatted away by Cell.
There's real kindness in you. Mr. Satan befriended Majin Buu and helped convince him to change his ways.
characters.flaw: You talk a bigger game than you can play.
characters.signature: A victory pose, a big speech and a crowd chanting your name.
characters.clashReason: they'd take credit for something you did

characters.name: Majin Buu
characters.title: The Big Kid
characters.summary: Playful, sweet and childlike. You love treats, friends and having fun, and you don't hide how you feel.
description: Like Majin Buu, you're a big kid at heart. His good side is playful, naive and childlike.
You've got a sweet tooth. Buu can turn people into candy.
Friendship changes you. Buu became friends with Mr. Satan, and turned over a new leaf.
characters.flaw: When you're upset, everyone knows about it, immediately.
characters.signature: A bag of sweets, a big hug and a tantrum if you don't get dessert.
characters.clashReason: they'd eat all the snacks before you got any

questions.text: A friend challenges you to a race. You...

options.text: Grin, and say yes immediately
Accept, and refuse to lose
Pull a muscle before the start, then claim you'd have won
Politely pass. Competing isn't really your thing

questions.text: Your weekend is completely free. You...

options.text: Read, and get ahead on your studies
Meditate somewhere quiet, completely alone
Tinker in the garage on a new invention
Eat sweets, and nap in front of the TV

questions.text: A friend calls in a panic and needs help fast. You...

options.text: Go, and turn out to be far more capable than anyone expected
Go, even though you're terrified
Show up, help quietly, then leave without a word
Make a big entrance, after the danger's passed

questions.text: Someone gets better than you at something you love. You...

options.text: Love it. Now you've got someone to train with
Train day and night until you're better again
Feel a bit discouraged, then cheer them on anyway
Work out how they did it, then improve on it

questions.text: A friend skips something important to go and have fun. You...

options.text: Give them a stern lecture they won't forget
Say nothing, but look very disappointed
Ask if you can come too
Cover for them, then feel guilty about it all day

questions.text: The washing machine breaks down. You...

options.text: Fix it yourself, and make it better than before
Pay someone to fix it, and take the credit
Leave it. Someone else will probably notice
Insist it gets fixed properly, today

questions.text: You're hosting a birthday party. You...

options.text: Make sure there's dessert. A lot of dessert
Make it a show, with you as the star
Organise every detail, and boss everyone around
Do the bare minimum, and act like you never wanted a party

questions.text: Someone criticises you in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Get furious, then quietly use it as fuel
Laugh it off
Explain, loudly, exactly why they're wrong
Make a joke about yourself before they can

questions.text: A friend wants to quit their course to chase a dream. You...

options.text: Tell them, firmly, they need a back-up plan
Tell them to go for it
Help them find a way to do both
Offer to fund it, if the plan is actually good

questions.text: You get caught doing something embarrassing. You...

options.text: Pretend you meant to do it all along
Turn red, then see the funny side
Get upset, and let everyone know about it
Act like nothing happened, with total dignity

questions.text: You're the strongest fighter on Earth, and a terrifying new enemy arrives. You...

options.text: Get excited. Finally, a real challenge
Insist on fighting them alone
Train someone younger to take them on
Announce you'll handle it, then quietly hide

questions.text: Someone in your family wants to go and fight a monster. You...

options.text: Forbid it. Absolutely not
Build them the best gear you possibly can
Offer to come along as back-up
Suggest asking the monster to be friends instead
